label: Magazine contract relinquished

notes: Earliest Arkansas Times story still to retrieve. This dated response falls after final August 2006 approval observation; do not move it earlier to obtain support.

date_basis: Source supports this public milestone; not necessarily the first public allegation.
notes: Include alleged conflict of interest, not vaccine efficacy or ordinary disagreement with the mandate. No quid pro quo established by this record.

description: Durbin used historical-regime comparisons while discussing prisoner treatment.

notes: Archive dates this episode June 22. Speech occurrence and onset of widespread criticism need separate coding; no misconduct finding. Earliest located public statement, not a claim about first media exposure.

label: Guantanamo apology
description: Durbin apologized on the Senate floor for the language used in his earlier speech.
date_basis: June 21 Congressional Record and same-day reporting.
notes: Same episode as June 14; never count as independent scandal. Archive June 22 is subsequent reporting, not apology date.

label: Remarks controversy
description: Criticism of Biden’s Indian-accent remark; his office disputed its interpretation.
date_basis: Displayed publication date.
notes: Incident date unresolved. Earliest located report is not proven first exposure.

label: Inquiry closure
description: Ethics inquiry closed for insufficient evidence.
date_basis: Header November 13, URL November 14, 2005; exact reporting day unresolved.
notes: Clearance, not adverse onset. Month=2005-11. Need pre-window exposure history before treating this official as an unexposed comparison.

label: Unaccounted skybox fundraisers
description: Secondary source attributes an October 20 report of unaccounted fundraisers and repayment to The Hill.
date_basis: SourceWatch cites Josephine Hearn, The Hill, October 20, 2005; original not retrieved.
notes: Do not promote to verified first report until original or independent contemporary date confirmation. Underlying fundraiser years 2002 and 2003, not exact incident days.

label: Lobbyist letters and skybox payments

date_basis: AP syndication carries December 2 date.
notes: Same broad Abramoff episode as October candidate; not two independent shocks. A documented accounting problem supports inclusion; receiving contributions alone does not.

description: An investigation alleged conflicts between Feinstein’s appropriations role and her husband’s defense investments. Her office denied knowledge or influence over environmental cleanup contract awards.
date_basis: Issue is dated January 24–30; date uses issue start.
notes: Do not convert allegations into proven contract steering. The article reports contrary accounts of safeguards. Do not code later claims that she resigned because of scandal without separate verification. Earlier public concerns may exist.

label: FDIC conflict allegation and response
description: A report questioned a connection between Feinstein’s FDIC funding proposal and her husband’s firm. She denied any connection; the contract was competitively bid.
date_basis: April 22 Chronicle report explicitly identifies Tuesday report and denial; April 21 advocacy statement corroborates public controversy.
notes: No evidence of wrongdoing established here. Original Washington Times story returned 403; contemporaneous reporting and dated advocacy statement establish exposure. Advocacy demand does not establish an investigation opened.

label: Rental arrangement scrutiny
description: MPR reported criticism of Coleman’s rent from a campaign vendor, including missed payments. Coleman defended the arrangement.
date_basis: MPR timestamp June 30, 2008.
notes: MPR cites earlier National Journal reporting, so June 30 is not first exposure. Separate from archived October wife-employer lawsuit. Roster has no June/July 2008 polls; next observed month August, with May before.

label: Rental ethics complaint

date_basis: FEC Advisory Opinion 2009-12, page 3, explicitly dates request July 1, 2008.
notes: Official retrospective evidence dates the complaint, not first media exposure or finding of wrongdoing. A repost has June 30 header / July 1 URL inconsistency; prefer explicit FEC chronology. Same episode as June rental reporting; polling gap applies.

label: DSCC staff obtained Steele credit records
allegation_status: staff misconduct alleged; Schumer authorization denied
description: Reporting connected unauthorized opposition research by DSCC employees to the committee chaired by Schumer. The committee apologized and said it had reported the incident to prosecutors.
date_basis: Roll Call dated September21 explicitly identifies same-day Washington Post disclosure.
notes: Allegations concern subordinates; no finding that Schumer authorized access. Conduct occurred July2005; do not use conduct date as public exposure. Earliest located contemporary disclosure, not proof of first ever. Date verified; DSCC staff conduct, no finding Schumer authorized it. Separate from official-personal wrongdoing.

label: Mortgage gift to union leader Carla Katz
allegation_status: potential conflict alleged; loan not described as illegal
description: Corzine forgave a former partner’s mortgage; her union role raised prospective bargaining-conflict concerns. He denied a conflict.
date_basis: Contemporary report identifies August4 newspaper disclosure; NYT article copy carries that date.
notes: Loan made2002 and forgiven2004; report occurred during Senate tenure and gubernatorial campaign. Separate later gubernatorial contract negotiations. No inference of illegality. Aug4 supported by AP dateline/first-report statement and NYT reprint despite WP URL Aug5. Loan forgiveness not inherently unlawful; allegation is prospective union bargaining conflict.

label: Earlier report of worker dismissals after immigration audit
allegation_status: company reported dismissals; knowing violations not established

date_basis: May2006 identified retrospectively by Willamette Week; exact original article day not recovered.
notes: Date interval2006-05-01 through2006-05-31. Do not impute first-day exposure. Earlier original needed to establish precise allegations and onset. Month-only prior report known through 2008 retrospective quotation; no original day/source retrieved. Original may describe compliant dismissal after audit rather than knowing hiring, so eligibility pending.

label: Investigation of undocumented workers at Smith businesses
allegation_status: reported allegations; compliance denied; no hiring fine reported
description: Workers and local sources alleged undocumented employment at Smith-owned businesses. Smith maintained that the company followed hiring law; the article reported no immigration hiring fine.
date_basis: Publisher timestamp September9 2008,5pm PDT.
notes: Renewed reporting, not first exposure: same article cites May2006 coverage. Evidence includes indirect accounts; no finding of knowing unlawful hiring. Sept2008 election context. Publisher date Sep9 verified. Renewed reporting, not first onset; report relies largely on indirect evidence and denies any hiring fine.

label: Earlier Abramoff contribution controversy
description: A local report described Republican efforts to connect Reid’s donations to Abramoff and Reid’s denial of wrongdoing.
date_basis: Las Vegas Sun publisher timestamp December20 2005.
notes: Already ongoing by this report; Sunday interview discussed in story implies earlier public exposure. Contribution association alone is not proven misconduct. February2006 reporting cannot be first episode onset. Date supported by newspaper search text. Merely receiving donations associated with Abramoff is not a specific misconduct allegation; exclude narrow core.

label: Abramoff billing-record reporting
description: New billing-record reporting questioned Reid’s lobbying contacts and donations; his office denied improper influence.
date_basis: AP syndication dated February9; newspaper archive also labels February9 despite February10 URL.
notes: Later revelation within an already public episode. Near Torino but not valid first exposure. Platt subsequently disputed interpretation and accuracy of records; preserve rebuttal. Feb9 publication verified. More specific than 2005 association, but routine contacts/contributions are not independently proof of improper influence; disputed AP inference. Broad sensitivity unless explicit alleged misconduct rule qualifies.

label: Land transaction financial-disclosure controversy
allegation_status: reporting irregularity alleged; not established corrupt profit
description: Reporting questioned Reid’s disclosure of a land transaction through an LLC.
date_basis: AP syndication publication October11 2006.
notes: Separate episode from Abramoff. Ownership continued through LLC; avoid implying proceeds were from land in which he had no interest. Last observed polling month is October2006, limiting aftermath. Oct11 publication verified. Financial disclosure allegation; continued LLC ownership must not be described as no ownership interest.

label: Federal inquiry into nonprofit rental arrangement
allegation_status: investigation; denied wrongdoing; later closed without charges
description: News accounts reported a federal subpoena concerning Menendez’s rental arrangement with a nonprofit receiving federal assistance. He disputed allegations and the investigation’s timing.
date_basis: FactCheck contemporaneous source list identifies September8 Star-Ledger report; direct original retrieval failed.
notes: Earlier coverage dated August25 and ethics complaints lateAugust exist in citation trails; September8 is investigation-report milestone, not first exposure. Inquiry closed2011; do not back-project later unrelated convictions. Sep8 Star-Ledger citation verified in FactCheck; later subpoena-report milestone, not first onset. Probe target not publicly established then; do not state Menendez was confirmed criminal-investigation target.

label: Tribal lawyer’s donation account and Dorgan response

description: A tribal lawyer attributed a donation request to Abramoff; Dorgan denied that contributions drove his school-funding position.
date_basis: HeraldNet AP article dated November28,9pm, describes Monday disclosure.
notes: Article explicitly refers to coverage the preceding week; November28 is not first-ever exposure. Earlier March2005 claim that Dorgan backed another grant was corrected, not corroboration. Nov28 AP publication verified in search text; article itself says previous-week coverage. Donor instruction does not establish Dorgan quid pro quo. Preserve denial and do not use corrected March2005 claim.

Reporter Peter Overby.

date_basis: DOJ official report documents April24 public letter; same-day UPI coverage corroborates.
notes: Do not label conviction, full exoneration, or first exposure. DOJ documents March4 2007 acknowledgement before archive March5 date and March7 inquiry. Incident call occurred October2006, day unresolved. Apr24 UPI date verified in search text. Qualified admonition of 2007 episode, not new allegation/onset. Distinguish appearance finding from proven improper pressure.

description: Investigative reporting questioned a donor-connected mortgage and potentially personal PAC spending; Santorum’s aide defended the expenses as political.
